text:
alex.p: quick heads-up — we need to kick off the marketplace offer setup for AWS/GCP/Azure. goal: get minimal viable listing + legal signoff by EOW. who can own the asset bundle?

maria_g: I can own packaging + descriptions. need SKU mapping and pricing tiers from sales.

kevin_legal: tagging to flag EULA/data residency checks. send me the current terms you want to present, esp around support SLA and PII handling.

sam_infra: FYI there are two infra prerequisites: (1) publisher IAM account with org-level publisher role, (2) image/AMI/container artifacts in the right repo. I can share the exact policy snippet.

alex.p: @sam_infra can you paste the IAM policy and the artifact naming conventions here? priya, julian — any constraints from product or runtime we should call out?

sam_infra: sure — quick snippet below:
```
Policy: arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/MarketplacePublisherAccess
Required tags: redwood:offer-id, redwood:region, redwood:release
Artifacts: aws-ami-{{version}}-gpu, gcp-image-{{version}}-gpu, azure-image-{{version}}-gpu
```

priya_prod: product constraints: need to list two SKUs — "shared-hosted" and "dedicated-commit". default support window is business hours; enterprise tier will have 24/7 option. also mention recommended minimal GPU size for Dedicated: 1x A10 equivalent.

julian_eng: build artifacts note — add a checksum file and a small install script (install.sh) that validates kernel modules. marketplaces often reject without quickstart.

kevin_legal: thanks. for EULA, two asks: (1) explicit data processing clause for embeddings/LLM outputs, (2) indemnity cap aligned with standard SaaS terms. I'll draft redlines and circulate.

maria_g: packaging checklist I'm starting:
- product description short (1-2 lines)
- 3 screenshots or console gifs
- pricing matrix + billing SKU ids
- support contact + docs link
- legal artifact (EULA)
- architecture diagram (SVG or PNG)

alex.p: sales provided preliminary pricing tiers in the drive: https://rwd.example/marketplace/pricing — @maria_g please confirm SKU ids and update checklist.

ops-bot: deploybot: marketplace-ci pipeline triggered for artifact validation — run 1/3 checks completed.

sam_infra: FYI deployment pipeline failing on image validation (missing checksum). pushing fix now.

maria_g: timeline proposal: content + screenshots by tomorrow noon, legal redlines by tomorrow EOD, infra artifacts validated by Thurs morning, final submission Thurs afternoon. can everyone confirm?

kevin_legal: I can do redlines by EOD.

priya_prod: confirmed for product assets.

julian_eng: will have install.sh + checksum by tonight.

sam_infra: I'll finish artifact validation and IAM setup Thurs AM.

alex.p: perfect. once all green we'll schedule a brief listing review (15m) before submission. thanks all :tada:
